Win Penny, who has played an active part in providing our members with refreshments most Tuesdays and Saturdays thro'out the winter was taken seriously ill recently and has spent a considerable time in the Seymour ward of Kingston Hospital.
Our now regular correspondent Miss Minnie Bannister, alias Win Penny, commenting on the Paris Scene, said "I can't see anything in these see-through dresses, though Arthur's been trying to for years.
We would all like to convey our condolences to Arthur and Eric Penny on the sad passing away of Win.
